strategies.name: pre_market_high_low_breakout_or_retest_2m

entry_sequence.action: Identify the highest high and lowest low of price action between 3:00 a.m. EST and the New York market open (9:30 a.m. EST) on the 5-minute timeframe.
entry_sequence.rationale: These levels act as magnets and traps for liquidity.

entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to break above the pre-market high or below the pre-market low.
entry_sequence.rationale: A clean break confirms a potential long or short entry.

entry_sequence.action: For a breakout trade, wait for the 2-minute candle to close above the pre-market high or below the pre-market low, confirming the break.
entry_sequence.rationale: Confirmation is required to avoid early entries.

entry_sequence.action: For a breakout trade, wait for an increase in volume on the breakout candle.
entry_sequence.rationale: Volume elevation confirms the breakout is valid.

entry_sequence.action: Enter long at the close of the 2-minute breakout candle above the pre-market high, or enter short at the close of the 2-minute candle below the pre-market low.
entry_sequence.rationale: Entry is taken upon confirmation of the break.

entry_sequence.action: For a retest trade, wait for price to pull back into the previous high (for long) or previous low (for short) and make it support/resistance.
entry_sequence.rationale: The retest provides a second entry opportunity after the initial break.

stop.rationale: The stop loss is placed below the breakout candle (for long) or above the breakout candle (for short).

strategies.stop_management: Trail the stop-loss up at least to break even, ideally in profits, and continue to scale out as the trade moves in favor.

targets.rationale: Ideally, look for at least 1.5x of the original risk.
The speaker aims for 2x the original risk.

confluences.name: pre_market_range_identification
confluences.description: Identify the highest point of price action and the lowest point of price action between 3:00 a.m. EST and the New York market open.

confluences.name: breakout_or_retest_signal
confluences.description: Wait for price to trade into these areas to either look for a breakout trade, a break and retest trade, or even a liquidity sweep.

confluences.name: volume_confirmation
confluences.description: Look for an increase in the volume to confirm that the breakout is actually valid.

speaker_concepts.verbatim_description: The highest point of price action from 3:00 a.m. EST all the way up into New York market open.
The lowest point of price action from 3:00 a.m. EST all the way up into New York market open.
A trade taken when price makes a clean break above pre-market highs or below pre-market lows, confirmed by volume and candle close on a lower timeframe.
A trade taken when price pulls back into the previous high or low of the pre-market range, making it support/resistance before continuing in the direction of the breakout.
A brief fake out below or above a level (like London high/low) where price tries to break but fails and reverses, often triggering stops on both sides.
The stop is always going to go on the opposite side of the entry candle or below/above the breakout level.
